description: This file defines the Zend_Validate_StringLength class, which is a validator for checking if a string's length falls within specified minimum and maximum bounds. It includes methods for setting and getting length constraints, and for validating string length.

classes.name: Zend_Validate_StringLength
classes.description: A validator class for checking if a string's length is within specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validator with optional min and max length constraints.

methods.name: setMin
methods.description: Sets the minimum length constraint, throws exception if min > max.

methods.name: setMax
methods.description: Sets the maximum length constraint, throws exception if max < min.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the given string's length is within the min and max bounds.
